§6Machine type: §aBlast Furnace§r

Who could ever imagine the power of the Steam Age?
consume iron/wrought iron ingots and coke coals (blocks) to produce steel (and ash byproduct)
Default recipe time is 240s. More wrought iron and coal input will reduce process time.
actual progress time = default x parallels /((1 + 4 x Ratio of wrought iron input) x sqrt(Coke coal input))
process 50% of (wrought) iron input and consume all coke coal input at once.
minimum coke coal requirement:2 x (wrought) iron processed
Takes 8 hours of continuous run time to achieve maximum efficiency.
This improve coal efficiency by up to 800%. Reduce minimum coal requirement and calculate in actual progress time.
It is recommended not to force yourself to build it until you have enough resources.
Use the GUI mode button or a screwdriver to switch to primitive mode and process primitive blast furnace recipes, without wrought iron acceleration
You can use the channel:chisel to automatically convert chisel blocks when building, and you can see nei to preview the available blocks

[note]Hatches[/note]: Input Bus, Output Bus
Use a Hologram Projector (or the NEI structure preview) to see and auto-build the structure.

[note]Controller recipe[/note]: Assembler, LV
 - 128x Casing Firebricks
 - 192x Machine Bricked Blast Furnace
 - 16x Steel Small Gear
